summary: Iter 11 security regression completed for backend+frontend. All targeted app-side security checks passed, including OTP throttling while provider unavailable, OTP leakage blocking, JWT exp+jti enforcement/revocation, file token rejection, and team invoice denial. CORS behavior is confirmed split: local FastAPI allowlist works correctly; public preview ingress/proxy still mutates/fails CORS.

minor.issue: Public preview preflight still returns 400 while local backend preflight returns 200 with exact allowlisted origin; this is infrastructure/proxy divergence, not FastAPI CORS middleware behavior.

integration_issues.flow: Login -> request OTP for former demo admin phone (9999999999)
integration_issues.issue: UI correctly stays on login and does not navigate to OTP. User receives non-sensitive failure feedback/rate-limit message; no demo OTP/admin leakage observed.

action_items: Keep app CORS allowlist strict as implemented; do not relax to wildcard.
Escalate preview ingress/proxy CORS mutation (public OPTIONS 400 + wildcard ACAO behavior in preview path) to platform/infrastructure owners.
Optional hardening consistency: align frontend env naming with project convention (EXPO_BACKEND_URL vs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) if platform policy requires it.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py CORS middleware configuration is strict and correct locally (explicit allowlist, allow_credentials=false, restricted methods/headers).
frontend/src/api.ts currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; project policy text references EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming for consistency.
No static/demo OTP exposure paths observed in backend responses or login UI under production settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iter11_security_regression.py for regression baseline. Expect local CORS preflight to pass for configured origin and block evil origin; public preview preflight may still fail due to ingress/proxy layer.
rca_of_issue: Public-vs-local CORS divergence reproduces consistently: local direct backend URL returns expected allowlist behavior, while preview ingress/proxy path returns disallowed/modified CORS responses before normal app behavior. This indicates upstream header/policy mutation outside application code.
